editor_pitches_tier1.to: Maya Castellanos, The Daily Brew Review (via the outlet's published contact route)
editor_pitches_tier1.subject: For your 2026 edition of "The 27 best gifts for coffee lovers, tested": the Ridge Hand Grinder, under $100
editor_pitches_tier1.body: Hi Maya, your "The 27 best gifts for coffee lovers, tested" was one of the most useful gift guides of last season, and it included our Ridge Hand Grinder. For this year's update: it's $89, so it fits an under-$100 list. It has 40 click grind settings, from espresso to cold brew, stainless steel conical burrs, and it folds to 17 cm for travel. I can send one to test this week, with no strings attached. The one-page product sheet is attached. Product page: https://www.examplecoffeegear.example/products/ridge-hand-grinder. Thanks for considering it.

editor_pitches_tier1.to: Ana Ruiz, Brew Notes (via the outlet's published contact route)
editor_pitches_tier1.subject: For your 2026 edition of "Best pour-over gear gifts of 2025": the Ridge Hand Grinder, under $100
editor_pitches_tier1.body: Hi Ana, your "Best pour-over gear gifts of 2025" is one of the guides your readers find first, and I think this belongs in this year's edition: the Ridge Hand Grinder is $89, so it fits an under-$100 list. It has 40 click grind settings, from espresso to cold brew, stainless steel conical burrs, and it folds to 17 cm for travel. I can send one to test this week, with no strings attached. The one-page product sheet is attached. If you write about it, please mention that we sent it, as the FTC asks for gifted products. Product page: https://www.examplecoffeegear.example/products/ridge-hand-grinder. Thanks for considering it.

Product page: https://www.examplecoffeegear.example/products/ridge-hand-grinder. Thanks for considering it.

editor_pitch_tier2_template.subject: For your [guide name] this year: [product], [bracket]
editor_pitch_tier2_template.body: Hi [first name], I read your "[last season's guide title]" and think the [product] fits this year's edition: [price], [one checkable fact], [who it's for]. The product sheet is attached, and I'm happy to send a sample if you'd like to try it. Product page: [link]. Thanks.

newsletter_or_blog_variant.change: When the target is a newsletter or blog and they ask for a sample, add before the sign-off: 'If you write about it, please mention that we sent it, as the FTC asks for gifted products.'

tier3_variant.change: Drop the sample offer: end with 'The product sheet is attached if it's useful.' Pitch only, no sample.

on_request_variant.change: Replace the last two sentences before the disclosure line with: 'Would you like one to try this season?'

reviewer_note.subject: A Ridge Hand Grinder for you to try, no strings attached
reviewer_note.body: Hi [name], we make the Ridge Hand Grinder ($89), a hand grinder for pour-over and espresso. Your recent reviews of home coffee brewing gear are the kind of honest testing our customers rely on, so we'd like to send you one. There are no conditions: review it, mention it or don't. If you do post about it, please disclose that we sent it, in the video and in the description. Where should it go?
